## Custom GUI Mod v1.2.8

v1.2.8 introduces the Rune Resource & Action Foundation. The active resource model is now fixed, resource mutations use a shared server-side contract, and retired lightning data is no longer part of the current player/resource API.

### Added
- Added a fixed active resource catalog: `coins`, `crystals`, `rune_dust`, `rune_shards`, and `rune_cores`.
- Added a shared server-side resource action contract for affordability checks, safe spending, and grants.
- Added regression coverage for the fixed resource catalog and resource-action foundation.

### Fixed
- Resource spending is now guarded against negative balances through the shared server-side spending path.
- New player data no longer recreates the retired lightning field.

### Changed
- Paid rune awakening now spends resources through the shared resource action contract.
- Custom mob rewards now grant resources through the same shared contract.
- `/customresource` is now read-only for listing resources and checking balances; dynamic resource creation and deletion are no longer supported.

### Removed
- Removed the legacy lightning getter/setter player API.
- Removed dynamic custom-resource creation and deletion from the active resource model.

### Other
- This is a foundation release and does not finalize rune economy prices, progression balance, or full spending formulas.
- The rune resource hierarchy remains Rune Dust, Rune Shards, and Rune Cores.
- Existing rune ranks remain Ordinary, Improved, and Advanced.
- Rune upgrade remains a separate, unimplemented mechanic.
- Existing purchase, duplicate compensation, paid awakening, multi-status switching, and custom mob reward flows passed runtime regression checks.
- Feature, develop, and main CI validation completed successfully before release preparation.
- Updated the mod version metadata to `1.2.8`.

### Download
Use the attached `customguimod-1.2.8.jar` on both client and server.

Compatible resource pack: [RE:volution Resource Pack v1.1.0](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-resource-pack/releases/tag/v1.1.0), available in 64x64 and 128x128 variants.

**Full Changelog:** [v1.2.7...v1.2.8](https://github.com/Theyyk/re-volution-mod/compare/v1.2.7...v1.2.8)
